optional_callback.contract: callback?: Callback<...> accepts omitted or explicit undefined. Null and non-functions remain parameter errors.
optional_callback.implementation: All three RTT off handlers identify noCallback before validating a present callback; undefined invokes unregister-all for this environment.

cleanup_lifetime.fixed_source_singleton: commonlibrary/c_utils/base/include/singleton.h:92-145: DelayedSingleton stores a static shared_ptr and provides DestroyInstance; no production call_manager DestroyInstance use was found. Static owner destruction has no declared ordering relationship to N-API env cleanup.
cleanup_lifetime.original_risk: First RTT patch passed registration.get() and a pointer to a mutex owned by the singleton. With no queued work, owner destruction freed both while env cleanup still held the raw pointer. The new regression exercises owner-before-env ordering with and without pending work.
cleanup_lifetime.fix: Cleanup hook owns an independent shared_ptr holder. The registration owns its own mutex; service queueing and removal take that mutex inside the original group lock. Normal off removes the hook and frees its holder; env cleanup consumes the holder. If hook removal fails, the holder survives until env cleanup.
cleanup_lifetime.scope: Only the original four approved upstream files; no singleton-wide changes or backend emulation.
